Writes the normalized vector into a2 and returns a2. Reads the two packed-qword globals qword_5AF938 and qword_5AF948 as math constants (contents not in packet).

operations.description: Load input vector components: a3->m64_u64 (x,y) into m64_u64 and the low dword of a3[1] into v3/v15 (z).
Accumulate the squared length: v4 = pfmul(a3->m64_u64, a3->m64_u64) + pfmul(v3, v3), then v5 = pfacc(v4, v4) to horizontally sum the two lanes.
Approximate the reciprocal square root v6 = pfrsqrt(v5) and refine it to v7 = pfrcpit2(pfrsqit1(pfmul(v6, v6), v5), v6).
Build the packed scale multiplier v17 = PAIR64(a1, low32(v7)) (scalar a1 in the high lane, refined rsqrt low dword in the low lane); compute v8 = pfmul(v5, v7) and v14 = pfmul(highlane(v8), v17).
Call PackedFloatingPointMath() at 0x005295E0 to set up the packed-math path before the magnitude comparison.

Compare v9 = pfcmpge(pand(v8, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF), 0x3400000034000000); extract v11 = low byte of the high-dword mask. If (v11 & 1) != 0, scale the components: v16 = lowlane(v14), then v15 = pfmul(v15, v16) (z) and m64_u64 = pfmul(m64_u64, v16) (x,y).
Write the normalized result into a2: a2->m64_u64 = scaled (x,y); a2[1].m64_u64 = pack(lowlane(v15), v13) for (z, magnitude); flush MMX state with femms; return a2.

clean_pseudocode: // 3DNow!/MMX normalize of a 3-component vector packed as two qwords.
// a1 is a scalar float placed into the high lane of the scale multiplier.
f64 len2 = pfmul(xy,xy) + pfmul(z,z);          // per-lane squared terms
f64 sum = pfacc(len2, len2);                   // horizontal sum -> v5
f64 rsqrt = pfrsqrt(sum);                      // v6, then refined v7
f64 mag = pfmul(sum, rsqrt);                   // v8 = pre-normalized magnitude
